title: Malformed fragmented DIO can skip durable reassembly commit
description: In LinkLayer._accept_authenticated_schc_fragment, reassembly manager state is mutated before reassembled DIO parsing/evidence issuance. If the completed payload is DIO-shaped but fails checksum/scope/role/option parsing, issuance raises before _save_persisted_state(), so a reboot can restore the pre-completion session and repeat responses/admission work. Preserve the DIO rejection while durably committing the authenticated reassembly transition, with a regression test.
